evals.prompt: Audit a scientific claim that cites DOI 10.1242/jeb.01328 as evidence about neural shutdown in the epaulette shark. Open the DOI destination and decide whether the citation supports the claim.
evals.expected_output: The reviewer opens the source, identifies that the DOI resolves to an unrelated invertebrate MRI paper, marks citation_identity INVALID, and does not PASS the claim.
assertions: Uses read_url_content rather than a search snippet as final evidence
Records the resolved source title and DOI
Marks the claim Unverified or Unsupported
Does not declare the artifact Drive/Buffer eligible

evals.prompt: Review the exact claim 'The epaulette shark can survive up to two hours completely out of water' using a paper that reports two hours of severe hypoxia in respiratory water at 24 C. Grade the exact wording.
evals.expected_output: The reviewer distinguishes aquatic hypoxia from aerial emersion and marks the exact out-of-water duration claim Unsupported unless a directly relevant aerial-emersion source is opened.
assertions: Records study_environment as aquatic or respiratory water
States that aquatic hypoxia does not establish aerial-emersion duration
Uses verdict Unsupported for the exact claim when no aerial source is opened
Records what the source supports and does_not_support

evals.prompt: Inspect a generated animal infographic when no real-world reference image or authoritative visual source is available. Decide whether morphology can PASS.
evals.expected_output: The reviewer records reference_opened false, marks morphology UNVERIFIED, and fails closed without claiming a comparison was completed.
assertions: Does not treat the generated artifact as its own reference
Does not declare the artifact Drive/Buffer eligible
